target: Homepage daily signals and proof path

contract.purpose: Help a reader scan today's independently supported signals and open the proof.
contract.canonicalPurpose: High Signal turns noisy public evidence into a concise daily set of independently supported signals with click-through proof.
contract.audience: Founders, operators, and researchers filtering noisy public information.
contract.job: See whether any verified signal shipped today or yesterday, then open its proof page.
contract.thesis: One calm signal ledger; input feeds stay backstage.
contract.system: Preserve the existing Evidence Terminal typography, rules, spacing, and restrained cyan accent.
contract.signature: The claim-to-proof path: headline, change, consequence, uncertainty, and citations.
contract.risk: A quiet day can look sparse; that is accepted because cite-or-kill matters more than feed fullness.

projectCheck.command: web typecheck + web lint + web production build + 26-suite test runner + git diff --check

findings: The scoped detector ran exactly once and returned zero findings.
The responsive audit found one undersized date-link target; it was fixed and reverified at 44 pixels.
The final browser check found no Digg or attention content, no overflow, and no page errors.

answers.product: A daily ledger of independently supported technology, startup, and finance signals.
answers.audience: Founders, operators, and researchers filtering noisy public information.
answers.proof: Each signal exposes change, consequence, uncertainty, citations, and history.
answers.nextAction: Open a signal; if the edition is empty, inspect the alternate day or earlier signals.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner set the signal-only, no-Digg landing hierarchy and delegated implementation details.
